selected_records.title: Conversational versus Dashboard Explainable AI for UAV Intrusion Detection: An Empirical Study of Operator Trust and Reliance

article.body:
**ArXiv record lists study of explainable AI interfaces for UAV intrusion detection**

An arXiv record dated 11 August 2026 lists an empirical study titled “Conversational versus Dashboard Explainable AI for UAV Intrusion Detection: An Empirical Study of Operator Trust and Reliance.” Its title identifies a comparison of interface types and operator trust and reliance, but the supplied record contains no abstract or results.

It does not identify a UAV platform, autonomy level, sensors, payload or test environment. No operational capability demonstration, production status or deployment is established by the available information.
